newsitem.title: USA: CSC buys three units of Swiss firm.
newsitem.headline: CSC buys three units of Swiss firm.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp bought three business units of Gruppe fur Angewandfe Informatik (GfAI), a Swiss information technology firm,for undisclosed terms.

The units are dedicated to telecommunications, government and industry, and technology development. Staff, assets and contracts of those units will be transferred to CSC. The three units posted revenues of nearly $18 million last year.

The company will add 150 technology professionals, 115 in Switzerland, 20 in Slovakia and the rest in Germany and the Czech Republic. Transferred staff will join CSC Ploenzke, a CSC unit in Germany with offices throughout Europe. The deal will almost double CSC's presence in Switzerland.
CSC designs and integrates computer and communications systems.
